title: Rebuild verification and frontend codebase cleanup (unused/redundant removal)

requirements.summary: Ensure the frontend compiles cleanly and initial load reliably renders the Dashboard without crashes after cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: `dfx build` (or equivalent project build) completes successfully.
Opening the app shows the Dashboard without a blank screen or crash.

file_operations.description: Re-validate the root view wiring (Dashboard as default), remove/adjust any now-unused imports introduced by cleanup, and ensure the app still mounts/render-stabilizes on first load (no runtime exceptions during storage load/sanitize paths).
Confirm Dashboard render path remains dependency-clean after cleanup (no missing imports; dialogs/tiles still render) and address any TypeScript issues exposed by deleted/trimmed modules.

requirements.summary: Remove unused/redundant frontend files and dead code paths while preserving all current app behavior (localStorage persistence and all existing flows).
acceptanceCriteria: No unused modules remain that are not imported/used anywhere in the app (as verified by TypeScript/compiler and a repo-wide search).
Any removed files are also removed from all import sites; the app still runs and core flows still work.
No dead/unused types, exports, or helper functions remain in modules that are still kept.

file_operations.description: Remove the intentionally-empty placeholder hook module (currently only exports `{}`) if it is not imported anywhere; ensure no remaining references/imports exist and the project still type-checks.
Trim any dead/unused exports or helper logic that is no longer referenced after removing redundant modules, while preserving localStorage persistence behavior and legacy cleanup behavior.

requirements.summary: Target cleanup of legacy/persistence/querying scaffolding on the frontend, removing clearly unused placeholders and ensuring no broken references remain.
acceptanceCriteria: Any intentionally-empty placeholder modules (e.g., a hook file that only exports `{}`) are removed if not imported anywhere.
Backend `backend/main.mo` contains only code that is required for the running app; unused type-only declarations are removed if they are not referenced.
After cleanup, there are no broken references in build output (no missing file/module errors).

file_operations.description: As part of legacy scaffolding cleanup, delete this empty placeholder file and ensure all imports (if any) are removed so there are no missing-module build errors.

Keep the frontend backend typing surface minimal and non-redundant (remove unused declarations if safe), while preserving compatibility with existing immutable actor/auth hooks that reference the backend type.
